remarks: Welcome home to this modern 1bedroom/1bathroom unit in the heart of Downtown Stamford at The Biltmore. This condo has been beautifully updated - new wood floors throughout, fully renovated kitchen and bathroom, in-unit washer and dryer and recessed lighting throughout. Facing east looking out onto a lush courtyard below with view of the water in the distance. The building boasts a 24/7 doorman, renovated gym and a resident lounge. It is within walking distance to the best restaurants, shops, cinemas, parks, entertainment and more that Stamford has to offer. Schedule your tour to see this unit today!
